items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I come with Jack Carey. Yeah. And your faces coming in the back. ... That's when Mutt Carey left. That's when I come in.

ctx.x: Ask him where did Mutt Carey go when he left Jack?

Where did Mutt Carey go when he left Jack? He was in Chicago, California. Went back over there. I think he come back here and died, I think. Know he died up there? California. Oh yeah, that's right, yeah. He was with the kid over there, I think. You know Eddie Gordon, didn't he? He was a good little bass. Me and him was the first one to let's take a hot. You know, all the rest of the band stopped and just let the bass. It's too hot. It's too hot.
